title: P1 — .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl lost 404 rows in ONE commit (b88f6bad, 'close PERF-012'): only the closed row survived, so 38 non-terminal rows (26 pending incl. QA-DUCKBRAIN-010/011/012, TESTQ-2026-10-20-1/2, DOC-24, DB-SUPA-2/3/4/8, RELEASE-CUT-001) are gone from the canonical board; tick 625 then closed DF-0923-05/DF-2026-2 as events-only because neither row exists in the file
description:
REPRO (git, read-only, on this checkout)
1. `git show --stat b88f6bad` -> `.coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl | 1 insertion(+), 404 deletions(-)` — commit message is 'board: close PERF-012 as informative (AUG-096 measured, no action needed)' (author totalwindupflightsystems, 2026-10-20T20:32:14-05). Nothing in the message or the tree declares a compaction.
2. Before: `git show 7410c484:.coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl | wc -l` = 404 rows. At b88f6bad and every commit since (d47dc9b9, fbb77bfd=origin/main): `wc -l` = 1 row, and `jq -r .id` prints PERF-012 alone.
3. The single surviving row is exactly the row that commit claims to CLOSE, and its status is 'complete' — so this is not an 'open rows only' compaction, it is a filtered-read rewrite that wrote back one row (the same incident class documented in ~/.hermes/scripts/qa_board_append.py: 'a mangled command rewrote the board from an empty state and the git tail committed the deletion').
4. events.jsonl was NOT touched by b88f6bad, and it carries NO compaction/rebuild event for that time: the only board_migration event is 2026-07-31 (count 1), event_type census = audit 213 / task_created 107 / task_completed 100 / task_dispatched 33 / ... — no 'board_rebuild'/'compact' type exists.

WHAT WAS LOST (status census of the 404 rows at 7410c484)
363 complete, 9 done, 26 pending, 1 in_progress, 1 open, 1 failed, 3 null-status. The 38 non-terminal rows are the live queue and are now invisible to every board consumer (boardctl list/show, foreman dispatch, audits): DB-SUPA-2 (P0, in_progress), DB-SUPA-3/4 (P1), DB-SUPA-8, RELEASE-CUT-001 (P1 release cut, owner-gated), REVIEW-DUCKBRAIN-005, ROLLOUT-DUCKBRAIN-001, DF-0923-05, MUSTER-001 (failed), DF-2026-2, DOC-23, DOC-24, README-9..17, DB-SUPA-2-R1, INT-CI-3, QA-DUCKBRAIN-010, QA-DUCKBRAIN-011, QA-DUCKBRAIN-012, TESTQ-2026-10-20-1, TESTQ-2026-10-20-2.

DOWNSTREAM DAMAGE (measured, not inferred)
The next board commit after the shrink — fbb77bfd = origin/main, 'board: tick 625 — close DF-0923-05 (landed), fail DF-2026-2 (worker liveness)' — changed ONLY events.jsonl (`git show --stat fbb77bfd` = 1 file, 2 insertions) and appended two close events for DF-0923-05 (status done) and DF-2026-2 (status failed). Neither row exists in tasks.jsonl at origin/main, so the canonical board has no record that those two rows ever existed or were closed: a row closure can now land as an event-only no-op, silently. That is the failure mode to close, not just the row count.

TOOL EXCULPATION (repro, so the fix is aimed at the real writer)
On a copy of the 404-row board (/tmp/boardrepro-923697/.coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl): `boardctl -C <dir> update PERF-012 --status complete --evidence-run-id QA-REPRO-1 --note 'repro probe'` -> 'updated task PERF-012' with 404 rows still present; the same update with `--replace` -> 404 rows still present. So the fleet board writer's update path is NOT the truncator; the rewrite that lost the rows ran out-of-band (shell/python) and was then committed with a board-only pathspec. (A shrink guard would have refused it regardless of which writer produced it.)

GUARD GAP (why nothing stopped it)
The fleet already has this gate and this repo does not: crier ships scripts/check-board.sh with the DF-CRIER-426/429/434/442 shrink policy — nonblank record counts of BOTH canonical files must not decrease, compared as `worktree vs HEAD` AND `HEAD vs HEAD^1` (--staged-index compares index vs HEAD), loss diagnostics naming the file and every lost row id, and an explicit exact `BOARD_ALLOW_SHRINK=1` hatch that still refuses an EMPTY board file. This repo has no equivalent: `grep -n 'board\|shrink\|tasks.jsonl' scripts/pre-commit` prints nothing (the tracked hook is gitleaks + tests + lint), and the installed hook in this checkout is the Hermes global hooksPath -> gitreins guard, which reads Go/source, never the board. So a 404-row deletion commits with the guard green.

RECOVERY (exact, lossless — the rows are all in git)
`git show 7410c484:.coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl > .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl` (restores all 404 rows), then re-apply the only intended edits made since: PERF-012 -> complete + its foreman_note (that is b88f6bad's own payload, recoverable with `git show b88f6bad:.coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl`), and the tick-625 closures for DF-0923-05 (done) and DF-2026-2 (failed). Then `python3 ~/.hermes/scripts/board_validate.py .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl` and `boardctl validate`.

ACCEPTANCE
1. `.coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl` at HEAD holds the 404-row id set of 7410c484 minus intended closures: `comm -23 <(git show 7410c484:... | jq -r .id | sort) <(jq -r .id <board> | sort)` prints nothing, `boardctl validate` exits 0, and the 38 non-terminal ids above are queryable with `boardctl show <id>`.
2. A shrink guard runs on the commit path: prove it REFUSES a staged shrink of tasks.jsonl (fixture: stage the 404-row board against a 1-row HEAD) naming both counts and the lost ids, exits 0 for an unchanged board, and permits an intended deletion only under an explicit BOARD_ALLOW_SHRINK=1 (which must still refuse an emptied file). Cite the fixture run and the wired hook/CI line.
3. A row close/update whose id is ABSENT from tasks.jsonl FAILS LOUDLY (nonzero, naming the id) instead of appending an events-only closure — prove with the DF-0923-05/DF-2026-2 shape from fbb77bfd.

SCOPE FENCE
Board storage + guards only. Do not re-litigate the 363 already-complete rows' content and do not touch product source. Do not add AGENTS.md assertions.

RELATED (cited, not refiled): BOARD-INTEGRITY-001 (complete, 2026-10-02) fixed the CONCURRENT-append corruption class in board_append.py (flock + JSON validation) — different mechanism, different tool, so this is not a recurrence of that row; QA-DUCKBRAIN-008 (complete) is the ui-probe probe-port row.
